'''Sportklub Austria Klagenfurt''' is an [[Football in Austria|Austrian]] professional [[association football|football]] club based in the [[Carinthia|Carinthian]] capital [[Klagenfurt am Wörthersee|Klagenfurt]]. The club currently compete in the [[Austrian Regionalliga]], following relegation from the [[2. Liga (Austria)|2. Liga]] in [[2025–26 Austrian Football Second League|2025–26]]."}}
